## make the matrix

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
```

```{r}
sample_matrix <- 
  crossing(
    site = c("PAL", "JCR", "LOM"),
    drought = c("ROS", "SKY"),
    rewet = c("WET", "DRY")
  )
```

```{r}
writexl::write_xlsx(sample_matrix, path = "data_output/sample_matrix.xlsx")
```
